description: This file contains functions for quantization and dequantization in video encoding, specifically for H.263 and MPEG standards, including intra and inter block processing, DC component handling, and related scaling and clipping operations.

methods.name: cal_dc_scalerENC
methods.description: Calculates the DC quantization scale based on the quantizer parameter and type.

methods.name: BlockQuantDequantH263Inter
methods.description: Performs quantization and dequantization for inter macroblocks in H.263, handling both AC and DC components.

methods.name: BlockQuantDequantH263Intra
methods.description: Performs quantization and dequantization for intra macroblocks in H.263, handling both AC and DC components.

methods.name: BlockQuantDequantH263DCInter
methods.description: Handles quantization/dequantization for DC component in H.263 inter macroblocks.

methods.name: BlockQuantDequantH263DCIntra
methods.description: Handles quantization/dequantization for DC component in H.263 intra macroblocks.

methods.name: BlockQuantDequantMPEGInter
methods.description: Performs MPEG standard quantization/dequantization for inter macroblocks.

methods.name: BlockQuantDequantMPEGIntra
methods.description: Performs MPEG standard quantization/dequantization for intra macroblocks.

methods.name: BlockQuantDequantMPEGDCInter
methods.description: Handles MPEG quantization/dequantization for DC component in inter macroblocks.

methods.name: BlockQuantDequantMPEGDCIntra
methods.description: Handles MPEG quantization/dequantization for DC component in intra macroblocks.
